methods.summary: Verifies a block's state against an authenticated header.
methods.description:
Verifies a block's state against an authenticated header.

The witness must recompute `stateRoot`, then every leaf is classified. With
state writes, any leaf that is not a named write, a carried parent value or
MARF bookkeeping is a hidden write. Without them the diff is still proven,
since every leaf is in the block: carried leaves are told apart only through
`parentLeaves`, and the remaining writes come back unnamed.

methods.summary: Thrown for a malformed block body or a transaction root mismatch.
methods.description: Thrown for a malformed block body or a transaction root mismatch.

methods.summary: Hashes a block's transactions and checks them against the header.
methods.description:
Hashes a block's transactions and checks them against the header.

Each transaction is hashed to its txid and checked against the header's
`tx_merkle_root`. The body after `header.byteLength` is a u32 count, then the
transactions back to back. It returns null when the bytes are the header
alone, as a source that serves headers only does. It throws [`TransactionsError`](/docs/verify-reference#m-TransactionsError) on a malformed body, trailing bytes or a root
mismatch.

Computes the `tx_merkle_root` over transaction ids.

A leaf is H(0x00 ‖ txid) and a node is H(0x01 ‖ l ‖ r). An odd level
duplicates its last node, and a lone leaf is still paired with itself, so a
one-transaction block hashes H(0x01 ‖ leaf ‖ leaf).

methods.summary: Describes a verification as one line per link and a verdict.
methods.description:
Describes a verification as one line per link and a verdict.

It is the human view, shared by the CLI and the browser checker. Ancestry
appears only below the checkpoint. `rows` says whether the caller asked for
the rows link.

returns.type: { lines: LinkLine[]; verdict: { ok: boolean; text: string } }

methods.summary: Verifies blocks from one checkpoint against one source.
methods.description:
Verifies blocks from one checkpoint against one source.

It caches the Bitcoin header chain, proven signer sets and fetched headers
across calls.

fields.name: checkpoint
fields.description: Defaults to MAINNET_CHECKPOINT.

fields.name: rows
fields.description:
Also prove the block's indexed vm_events rows against its diff: reads
the source's `getVmEvents`, which bill as Index rows on the Secondlayer
API. Off by default. Naming the diff's writes (`getStateWrites`, free on
`/v1/proofs`) is always on when the source has them.

fields.name: onStep
fields.description:
Called once per link as it passes, in the order the verifier proves them.
Failures arrive in the result, not here.

constants.name: LINKS
constants.summary: The chain of links, in the order verifyBlock walks them.

types.name: Ancestry
types.summary: How a block below the checkpoint was tied to it.

fields.name: fromHeight
fields.description: Trusted descendant it was proven from: the checkpoint, or a block proven below it earlier.

fields.name: via
fields.description:
`parents`: each header hashes to the parent id its child commits to.
`marf`: one MARF proof of `__MARF_BLOCK_HEIGHT_TO_HASH::<height>` against
the descendant's state root.

fields.name: height
fields.description: MARF height of the block (its Stacks chain length).

fields.name: parentBlockId
fields.description: Parent block id from the authenticated header.

fields.name: stateRoot
fields.description: state_index_root from the authenticated header.

fields.name: writes
fields.description: The block's state_writes; null when the source has none (names unavailable).

fields.name: rows
fields.description: Indexed rows to prove against the diff.

fields.name: parentLeaves
fields.description:
Leaves of the parent's own trie, from a parent witness whose root the
caller checked against the parent header: each is the parent state's
value at its path. Resolves carried leaves without a proof per leaf.

fields.name: parentHolds
fields.description:
True iff the leaf's value is stored at its path in the parent's state
(proven by the caller). Asked only with state_writes, for leaves the
parent's own trie does not explain.

fields.name: txid
fields.description: sha512/256 of the transaction bytes, hex.

fields.name: raw
fields.description: The consensus-serialized transaction.

fields.name: ok
fields.description:
Every step passed. At or above the checkpoint: header, burn binding,
signatures, state root, names and rows. Below it: ancestry, header,
state root, names and rows (and the burn binding when Bitcoin reaches it).

fields.name: blockHash
fields.description: Nakamoto block hash (the header's signer sighash), hex. Absent for epoch 2.x.

fields.name: consensusHash
fields.description: The header's consensus hash, hex.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Nakamoto header timestamp, Unix seconds. Absent for epoch 2.x.

fields.name: stateRoot
fields.description: The header's state_index_root, hex: what the witness must hash to.

fields.name: ancestry
fields.description: Set for blocks below the checkpoint, which need no signatures.

fields.name: bitcoinBlockHash
fields.description: Display-order hex.

fields.name: transactions
fields.description:
The block's transactions, checked against the header's tx_merkle_root.
Absent for epoch 2.x blocks and when the source served the header only.

fields.name: writes
fields.description: Every state_writes row the names step checked, in ordinal order.

fields.name: rowsChecked
fields.description: vm_events rows proven against the diff.

fields.name: failures
fields.description: Empty when ok. The first entry is the first broken link.

types.name: BurnPreimage
types.summary: Sortition preimage behind a consensus hash.

fields.name: burnHeight
fields.description: The source's claimed burn height: a hint for how far to sync Bitcoin headers, never trusted.

fields.name: BYTES_PER_ELEMENT
fields.description: The size in bytes of each element in the array.

fields.name: buffer
fields.description: The ArrayBuffer instance referenced by the array.

fields.name: byteLength
fields.description: The length in bytes of the array.

fields.name: byteOffset
fields.description: The offset in bytes of the array.

fields.name: copyWithin
fields.type: (target: number, start: number, end?: number) => Bytes
fields.description:
Returns the this object after copying a section of the array identified by start and end
to the same array starting at position target

fields.name: every
fields.type: (predicate: (value: number, index: number, array: Bytes) => unknown, thisArg?: any) => boolean
fields.description: Determines whether all the members of an array satisfy the specified test.

fields.name: fill
fields.type: (value: number, start?: number, end?: number) => Bytes
fields.description: Changes all array elements from `start` to `end` index to a static `value` and returns the modified array

fields.name: filter
fields.type: (predicate: (value: number, index: number, array: Bytes) => any, thisArg?: any) => Uint8Array
fields.description: Returns the elements of an array that meet the condition specified in a callback function.

fields.name: find
fields.type: (predicate: (value: number, index: number, obj: Bytes) => boolean, thisArg?: any) => number | undefined
fields.description:
Returns the value of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and undefined
otherwise.

fields.name: findIndex
fields.type: (predicate: (value: number, index: number, obj: Bytes) => boolean, thisArg?: any) => number
fields.description:
Returns the index of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and -1
otherwise.

fields.name: forEach
fields.type: (callbackfn: (value: number, index: number, array: Bytes) => void, thisArg?: any) => void
fields.description: Performs the specified action for each element in an array.

fields.name: indexOf
fields.description: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a value in an array.

fields.name: join
fields.description: Adds all the elements of an array separated by the specified separator string.

fields.name: lastIndexOf
fields.description: Returns the index of the last occurrence of a value in an array.

fields.name: length
fields.description: The length of the array.

fields.name: map
fields.type: (callbackfn: (value: number, index: number, array: Bytes) => number, thisArg?: any) => Uint8Array
fields.description:
Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array, and returns an array that
contains the results.

fields.name: reduce
fields.type: { (callbackfn: (previousValue: number, currentValue: number, currentIndex: number, array: Bytes) => number): number; (callbackfn: (previousValue: number, currentValue: number, currentIndex: number, array: Bytes) => number, initialValue: number): number; <U>(callbackfn: (previousValue: U, currentValue: number, currentIndex: number, array: Bytes) => U, initialValue: U): U; }
fields.description:
Calls the specified callback function for all the elements in an array. The return value of
the callback function is the accumulated result, and is provided as an argument in the next
call to the callback function.

fields.name: reduceRight
fields.type: { (callbackfn: (previousValue: number, currentValue: number, currentIndex: number, array: Bytes) => number): number; (callbackfn: (previousValue: number, currentValue: number, currentIndex: number, array: Bytes) => number, initialValue: number): number; <U>(callbackfn: (previousValue: U, currentValue: number, currentIndex: number, array: Bytes) => U, initialValue: U): U; }
fields.description:
Calls the specified callback function for all the elements in an array, in descending order.
The return value of the callback function is the accumulated result, and is provided as an
argument in the next call to the callback function.

fields.name: reverse
fields.description: Reverses the elements in an Array.

fields.name: set
fields.description: Sets a value or an array of values.

fields.name: slice
fields.description: Returns a section of an array.

fields.name: some
fields.type: (predicate: (value: number, index: number, array: Bytes) => unknown, thisArg?: any) => boolean
fields.description: Determines whether the specified callback function returns true for any element of an array.

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Sorts an array.

fields.name: subarray
fields.description:
Gets a new Uint8Array view of the ArrayBuffer store for this array, referencing the elements
at begin, inclusive, up to end, exclusive.

fields.name: toLocaleString
fields.type: { (): string; (locales: string | string[], options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string; }
fields.description: Converts a number to a string by using the current locale.

fields.name: toString
fields.description: Returns a string representation of an array.

fields.name: valueOf
fields.description: Returns the primitive value of the specified object.

fields.name: entries
fields.description: Returns an array of key, value pairs for every entry in the array

fields.name: keys
fields.description: Returns an list of keys in the array

fields.name: values
fields.description: Returns an list of values in the array

fields.name: includes
fields.description: Determines whether an array includes a certain element, returning true or false as appropriate.

fields.name: toBase64
fields.description: Convert the Uint8Array to a base64 encoded string

fields.name: setFromBase64
fields.type: (base64: string, offset?: number) => { read: number; written: number }
fields.description: Set the contents of the Uint8Array from a base64 encoded string

fields.name: toHex
fields.description: Convert the Uint8Array to a hex encoded string

fields.name: setFromHex
fields.description: Set the contents of the Uint8Array from a hex encoded string

fields.name: header
fields.description: Raw 80-byte header, bytes or hex. Trusted without validation.

fields.name: periodStartTime
fields.description:
Timestamp of the first block of the checkpoint's difficulty period
(height − height % 2016). Required when the checkpoint is not itself a
period start; needed to verify the next retarget.

fields.name: key
fields.description: MARF key, when a state_writes row names the leaf.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Leaf path, hex.

fields.name: valueHash
fields.description: sha512/256 of the stored value string, hex.

fields.name: txIndex
fields.description: Transaction of the last write; null for block-level writes.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The stored value string (hex of a Clarity value) the leaf holds; named writes only.

fields.name: named
fields.description: False when the source had no state_writes: the leaf may also be a carried copy.

types.name: Epoch2HeaderResponse
types.summary: An epoch 2.x header and the consensus hash its index block hash commits to.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Consensus-serialized StacksBlockHeader.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: What the link proved, why it failed, or why it was not checked.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Value string as Clarity stored it (hex for Clarity values), 0x prefix tolerated.

fields.name: proof
fields.description: Consensus-serialized TrieMerkleProof.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Low 7 bits = header version; high bit = shadow block.

fields.name: signerSignatures
fields.description: 65-byte recoverable signatures: recovery id, r, s.

fields.name: signerSighashPreimage
fields.description: Header bytes minus the signer_signature vec: the signer sighash preimage.

fields.name: byteLength
fields.description: Serialized header length; block bytes after this are the transactions.

fields.name: getBlock
fields.description: Raw Nakamoto block bytes (header first), by block id or height.

fields.name: getEpoch2Header
fields.description:
Epoch 2.x block header by index block hash: blocks below the checkpoint
from before Nakamoto. Without it only Nakamoto blocks verify.

fields.name: getMarfProof
fields.description:
MARF inclusion proof for a 32-byte path at `tipId`; null when the key is
absent. Blocks below the checkpoint also ask for
`__MARF_BLOCK_HEIGHT_TO_HASH::<height>`, whose value is no stored string:
only `proof` is read for it.

fields.name: getWitness
fields.description: State witness (wire v3) for a block.

fields.name: getBitcoinHeaders
fields.description: Raw 80-byte Bitcoin headers (hex or bytes) from height `from`.

fields.name: getStateWrites
fields.description:
Every MARF write of the block, in ordinal order; null (or empty) when
the source has none for it. Names the block's diff.

fields.name: getVmEvents
fields.description: Indexed vm_events write rows of the block, checked against its proven diff.

fields.name: named
fields.description: Every leaf is named (state_writes served) and classified.

fields.name: carried
fields.description: Unchanged values copied forward from the parent (proven at the parent).

fields.name: internal
fields.description: `__MARF_BLOCK_*` bookkeeping.

types.name: StateWrite
types.summary: One storage-layer MARF write (`state_writes` row), in block write order.

fields.name: tx_index
fields.description: Null for block-level writes outside any transaction.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Full MARF key, e.g. `vm::<contract>::0::<map>::<key hex>`.

fields.name: value_hex
fields.description: Hex of the stored value string's UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: stacks
fields.type: { header: string; cycle: number; signerSet: string }

fields.name: bitcoin
fields.description: Retarget-boundary Bitcoin header at or below the first burn block of `stacks.cycle`.

fields.name: cycle
fields.description: Reward cycle being proven (signer-set step).

fields.name: blockId
fields.description: Block the failure is about, when not the target.

fields.name: checkpoint
fields.description: Defaults to MAINNET_CHECKPOINT.

fields.name: rows
fields.description:
Also prove the block's indexed vm_events rows against its diff: reads
the source's `getVmEvents`, which bill as Index rows on the Secondlayer
API. Off by default. Naming the diff's writes (`getStateWrites`, free on
`/v1/proofs`) is always on when the source has them.

fields.name: onStep
fields.description:
Called once per link as it passes, in the order the verifier proves them.
Failures arrive in the result, not here.

fields.description: The row's ordinal within the block.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Full 32-byte trie path: `marfPath(key)`.
